notes.title: Developer Note
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, Hunters![/b][/h2][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]I am Kim Gwang Hoon,” the Development Producer of Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE.[/p][p]We are thrilled to greet you for the first time as the development team behind Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE.[/p][p]With Solo Leveling: ARISE already receiving so much love, developing a new game for PC and console players has brought us not only great excitement and anticipation but also a[b] fair share of fear and serious contemplation about venturing into the unknown[/b].[/p][p]Still, the desire to reinterpret the epic journey of Solo Leveling in a new dimension, and to [b]present new experiences and deeper gameplay aimed at PC and console that couldn’t be explored in ARISE[/b], has driven our strong spirit of challenge. Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is our bold new venture.[/p][p]
[/p][p]We understand that many of you may have -questions about our new game.[/p][p]To the current players of Solo Leveling: ARISE, we deeply empathize with your feelings that the arrival of Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE might mean we’re turning our attention away from Solo Leveling: ARISE. And to those of you waiting for Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE, we also recognize the concern that it might end up as nothing more than a simple port of Solo Leveling: ARISE.[/p][p]But please rest assured, [b]Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is an entirely different game, developed as an independent project by a separate team[/b].[/p][p][b]Solo Leveling: ARISE will continue to evolve on its own path, aiming to provide the best possible gameplay experience. [/b]At the same time,[b] Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is being developed as a distinct PC/console title [/b]with its own unique identity. We are doing our utmost to ensure that both projects live up to your expectations.[/p][p]Now, allow us to share more about how Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is being developed.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]“Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE” is a new game experience.[/b][/h3][p]What we would like to emphasize first and foremost is that Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is a full-package game[b]. [/b]Rather than relying on randomness when recruiting Hunters or crafting weapons, we’ve designed the game to [b]reward effort and strategy, allowing you to feel a true sense of achievement[/b]. All the Hunters, Sung Jinwoo and their weapons, and the joy of progression can be earned and enjoyed entirely through in-game play.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Hunter Recruitment[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/2531f20e11609e54f3a3b7be8ac997196e5d3a80.png"][/img][/p][p]『Now, you are not alone』[/p][p]By Sung Jinwoo’s side stands not only his shadows, but also [b]many skilled Hunters[/b] who fight alongside him. In Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE, you can offer each Hunter a [b]payment worthy of their abilities[/b] and recruit them to join you in battle.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Weapon Crafting[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/cf2fc5a2ed0c7ab9c1aa12bf9c3b3676c8ecea36.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]『Material Farming and Weapon Crafting』[/p][p]As a player, you can directly choose and craft your own weapons. [b]Defeat powerful bosses and use the materials you obtain to forge formidable weapons[/b] for Sung Jinwoo and the Hunters. By [b]combining various weapons and skill trees, you’ll be able to create a unique combat style[/b] that’s entirely your own.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]What Sets Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Apart[/b][/h3][p]The passion of Solo Leveling: ARISE now burns anew on PC and console with Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is built upon two core values.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]First, deeper and more refined action[/b].[/p][p]We’ve designed the controls to suit PC and console platforms, maximizing the thrill of weighty and precise combat.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Second, overwhelming immersion[/b].[/p][p]A world brought to life with next-level PC/Console graphics that will fully draw fans into the game’s story, delivering a truly immersive experience.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Visuals That Deepen Immersion[/b][/h3][p]We've pushed the visual quality of the game to its highest level, so that you can become [b]fully immersed in the world of Solo Leveling[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]Background Level Up[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/9f4d1e0e71daf18b1c17ba4f740e8982eb1f946c.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]『To the Battlefield』[/p][p]Now, You Are There. To bring the iconic moments from the webtoon to life more vividly, we’ve [b]significantly enhanced the detail and quality of the game’s environments[/b]. Though the game is based on the original webtoon, the backgrounds are portrayed in a style that bridges the gap between comic and realism, allowing you to not only feel as if you've stepped into the webtoon itself, but to [b]experience a whole new level of immersion[/b].[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Character Level Up[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/cc61ed2d465c1b7b328c0ebb853634040d146435.png"][/img]
[/p][p]『Character, A time for true Identity』[/p][p]
[/p][p]A brand-new customization system has been added, just for you.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Sung Jinwoo: Styled, Chosen, Completed by You.[/b][/p][p]You can personalize Sung Jinwoo by selecting his hairstyle and hair color, and equipping various facial accessories to create a version of him that’s truly one of a kind.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Highlight Your Party’s Personality.[/b][/p][p]You can also freely change the hair color of your fellow Hunters, letting their individuality shine even more. Mix and match hairstyles and colors across multiple Hunters to create a party that reflects your unique style.[/p][p]


[/p][h3][b]Combat with Strategic Depth[/b][/h3][p]We’ve built a combat system that goes beyond simple hack-and-slash,[b] maximizing the thrill of strategic decision-making and precise control[/b].[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Sung Jinwoo Skill Tree[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/bbeeec8d54b92a41375177a835e1465422685fb8.png"][/img]
[/p][p]『My Own Growth, My Own Skill Tree』[/p][p]Sung Jinwoo’s growth is entirely in your hands. Choose and develop[b] various skill trees, [/b]even the same Jinwoo can have a completely different combat style depending on your decisions. Grow him your way, with your own strategy.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Depth of Combat, Part 1: The Monarch System[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/386968eee77fb4a2a8c7ec8802f70fc711683c5d.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]『Monarch of Shadows, the power of Ashborn』[/p][p][b]It’s Time to Turn the Tide of Battle. [/b]We’ve implemented a Monarch Transformation system, a powerful feature that lets[b] Sung Jinwoo awaken as the Monarch of Shadows[/b]. In this form, Jinwoo unleashes devastating skills that overwhelm enemies and dominate the battlefield. Based on your feedback, we’re actively enhancing the impact and speed of combat to deliver an even more intense and overwhelming battle experience. Get ready for a fight that feels truly powerful.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Depth of Combat, Part 2: Parry System[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/31c5ca352b7fb5c26db8159e7418ad1bf5cddbff.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]『Control, and Parry』[/p][p]Take command of the battlefield. The parry system lets you precisely block enemy attacks,[b] offering the thrill of skillful control and heightening the tension[/b] of each encounter. Successfully parry an attack to trigger a QTE, [b]allowing you to exploit enemy openings and land a devastating counterstrike[/b].[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Depth of Combat, Part 3: Enhanced Hit Impact and Damage Feedback[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/73baeae4b9abd041ce7ec244c983ff25fb6910a7.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/39dc41436d3ef4026fb63fa6fd937d00b5b57f9a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]『Thrill of Battle』[/p][p]Feel every moment of battle as if you were truly there. [b]From the impact of striking enemies to the intensity of taking hits, [/b]every sensation has been amplified to deliver unmatched immersion, making it feel like you’ve thrown yourself right into the fight.  Every blow and every hit will set your heart racing.[/p][p]


[/p][list][*][p][b]Enjoy Battle Even More 1: Overdrive System[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]『Combat that Explodes with Personality』[/p][p]The Overdrive System is being developed to maximize Sung Jinwoo’s skill tree and each Hunter’s unique traits, delivering overwhelming fun in combat.[/p][p][b]With his skill tree–based Overdrive System, Sung Jinwoo dominates the battlefield.[/b] For example, when using the “Duel” skill tree, a special gauge will appear on the battle HUD. Once this gauge is filled to 100%, you can unleash a powerful skill specialized for that tree.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/174c7a808507435f13fe26459f1557f812942702.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hunters can showcase their individuality[b] in combat through their own unique Overdrive Systems.[/b] For example, the Hunter Choi Jong-In can unleash meteors around him after applying Burn to enemies a certain number of times, shaking the battlefield with abilities that highlight his distinctive traits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/4756310e6ac4702f1c8cded636d260e57290fccc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/9641f3fd85bb9be6013f62da9d3e7820660d7a47.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Enjoy Battle Even More 2: Chain Smash System[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]『Strategic Combos, Maximum Damage』[/p][p]The [b]Chain Smash System[/b] is a core mechanic that maximizes the synergy between skills. Triggered through additional input right after using a skill, Chain Smash grows stronger the more you chain it together.[/p][p]By strategically deciding when to activate Chain Smash during your combos, you’ll experience an entirely new level of combat excitement.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE’s Variety of Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cute Companion, Yaruru[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/34ad86277b58700298074cdc9e51a85bdd5cbb7b.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]『Yaruru may not speak, but gets the job done.』[/p][p]Adorable shadows have flown in from another world to assist Hunters. [b]Yaruru diligently picks up items, gathers resource[/b]s, and always supports you faithfully by your side. Though small, Yaruru is a reliable companion.[/p][p]Meet your very own companion by fulfilling special acquisition conditions.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]A Vast World Map and an Immersive Main Story[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/61874b453f607fff801572826ffdfe724092e8b1.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]『Immersion, with the Emotion of the Original』[/p][p]Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE invites you into a [b]world map and main story that faithfully capture the heart of the original work[/b]. Beyond the single chapter you experienced in the Demo version, the official release will feature Chapters 1 through 10 of the story. Each chapter will bring you new challenges and moving experiences to look forward to.[/p][p]

[/p][list][*][p][b]4-Player Multiplayer with Friends[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/31da1f1eb8815bc5671c3827daeb382b82a9578b.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]

[/p][p]『The Joy of Playing Together』[/p][p]Leveling up alone can be fun, but sometimes the true excitement comes from playing with friends. [b]Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE supports a multiplayer system for up to four players[/b].[/p][p]You can freely compose a party with any combination of Sung Jinwoo and Hunter parties. Whether it’s a full four-player Sung Jinwoo party, or a team of three Hunters and one Sung Jinwoo, you can strategize and enjoy cooperative gameplay. Conquer challenging dungeons together, defeat bosses, and experience the thrill of teamwork![/p][p]

[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Closing Remarks[/b][/h2][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Dear Hunters, that’s all for today’s update.[/p][p]Now it’s time for us to focus on developing the features we’ve introduced to you. As development progresses, if there are any new updates or things we’d like to share with you, we will greet you again through the Developer Notes.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]- Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Team -[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/8ad6bab2b35eb331b601a4e9c182d22d29a3c53e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.content: [p]Greetings Hunters. notes.title: Frequently asked questions (FAQ)
notes.content: [p][b]📌 Demo FAQ[/b][/p][p]1. Which platforms is the game available on?[/p][p]▶ You can play the game through Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]2. What are the minimum and recommended system requirements for playing the game?[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p]Minimum System Requirements[/p][/td][td][p]Recommended System Requirements[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]CPU: i5 4460[/p][p]Ram: 8GB[/p][p]Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050[/p][p]OS : Window 10 or higher[/p][/td][td][p]CPU: i5 9400[/p][p]Ram: 16GB[/p][p]Graphics: Geforce RTX 2060[/p][p]OS : Window 10 or higher[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]3. Which languages are supported in the game?[/p][p]▶ A total of 13 languages are supported in-game, with in-game voice available in Korean, Japanese.[/p][p][/p][p]4. A bug/issue has been found in the game.[/p][p]▶ We kindly ask for your understanding, as unexpected bugs or technical issues may occur in the demo version.[/p][p]Due to the nature of the demo, it will be difficult to address the reported issues immediately. However, we will do our best to deliver a stable and polished game at launch.[/p][p]If you discover any bugs or issues in the game, please report them through the Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Customer Support or Discord server.[/p][p]You can also join discussions and share stories with fellow Hunters there, so we warmly encourage your active participation![/p][p][url="https://help.netmarble.com/en/game/sololvcs?lcLocale=en" style="button"]Go to Customer Support[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/sololevelingoverdrive" style="button"]Join Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]5. A login failure pop-up is appearing when accessing the game.[/p][p]▶ You may encounter this pop-up when accessing the game in Steam offline mode. Please launch the game in online mode instead.[/p][p][/p][p]6. The tutorial or gameplay isn’t progressing.[/p][p]▶ If the tutorial or gameplay does not progress intermittently, reconnecting to the game should allow it to continue normally.[/p][p][/p][p]7. The camera rotates too quickly.[/p][p]▶ You can adjust the camera rotation sensitivity in the in-game Options - Controls.[/p][p][/p][p]8. A message appears saying Easy Anti-Cheat is not installed, and the game does not launch.[/p][p]▶ If this issue occurs, please follow these steps:[/p][p]Open the Steam launcher, go to your Library, right-click on Solo Leveling: ARISE Overdrive,[/p][p]select Properties > Installed Files > click Verify integrity of game files.[/p][p]Once the verification is complete, the game should launch properly.[/p][p][/p][p]9. Will the progress from the demo version carry over to the full release?[/p][p]▶ Progress made in the demo version will not carry over to the full version.[/p][p][/p][p]10. How long will the demo version be available?[/p][p][strike]▶ The demo version will remain playable even after the Steam Next Fest (SNF).[/strike][/p][p]▶ The demo version will be available until 8/27 (Wed) 17:00 (UTC+0).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/8ad6bab2b35eb331b601a4e9c182d22d29a3c53e.png"][/img]  [/p]

notes.title: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Hunters. [b]Level Up the Action.[/b]
This is Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE team.

Pleased to meet you, Hunters!
A demo of Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is now available.

While preparing the demo, we envisioned countless times the day we would finally meet you, Hunters — and now, we’re grateful that the day has come to share it with you.

We hope all our Hunters enjoy the game and we look forward to your support, interest, and valuable feedback. 

You can now download and play the game on Steam, and more details are provided below for Hunters.

[b]--- [/b]

📌 [b]Schedule[/b]
 - 6/9 (Mon) 16:00 (UTC+0)

📌 [b]Details[/b]
- Download and play the demo on Steam!

[b]\[How to Play the Demo][/b]
1. Visit the Steam website to download Steam
2. Launch Steam and log in to your account
3. Download and play Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE from the Steam Store page

📌 [b]Demo FAQ[/b]
1. Which platforms is the game available on?
▶ You can play the game through Steam.

2. What are the minimum and recommended system requirements for playing the game?
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Minimum System Requirements[/p][/th][th][p]Recommended System Requirements[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]CPU : i5 4460  [/p][p]Ram : 8GB  [/p][p]Graphic : Geforce GTX 1050  [/p][p]OS : Window 10 or higher[/p][/td][td][p]CPU : i5 9400  [/p][p]Ram : 16GB  [/p][p]Graphic : Geforce RTX 2060  [/p][p]OS : Window 10 or higher[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]3. Which languages are supported in the game?
▶ A total of 13 languages are supported in-game, with in-game voice available in Korean, and Japanese.

4. A bug/issue has been found in the game.
▶ We kindly ask for your understanding, as unexpected bugs or technical issues may occur in the demo version.
Due to the nature of the demo, it will be difficult to address the reported issues immediately. However, we will do our best to deliver a stable and polished game at launch.
We encourage you to join the Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Discord channel, where you can engage in active chats with other Hunters.
[b][url="https://discord.gg/sololevelingoverdrive"]\[Go to Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Discord][/url][/b]
* Please note that the Discord channel is operated only in English. 

5. A login failure pop-up is appearing when accessing the game.
▶ You may encounter this pop-up when accessing the game in Steam offline mode. Please launch the game in online mode instead. 

[b]---[/b]

Thank you.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/8ad6bab2b35eb331b601a4e9c182d22d29a3c53e.png"][/img][/p]
